messages:
sasha: heads-up — deploybot posted a plan for release/v2.7.3. provider plugin bumped 4.0 -> 4.2 and there's an iam/service-account tweak. plan summary: 4 resources changed. see <https://deploy/reports/abcd|plan>

deploybot: plan summary: 1 create, 2 update, 1 replace. state-lock ok. provider change detected (hash mismatch). run `terraform init -upgrade` to reconcile.

ryan: we should NOT roll 4.2 straight to prod. last time 4.2 caused a provider-side retry bug. can we pin a safer patch for canary?

maria: +1 pin for canary. suggest `~> 4.1.0` at root provider block and do a full canary in staging-canary first.

kevin: i can take the canary apply window tonight at 22:00 PST (2h slot). will do serial applies to reduce blast radius and run smoke. ops-bot, please stand by for alerts.

sasha: ok — hold prod until canary clears. also add a short rollback playbook to the release notes: minimal steps to restore previous tfstate + revert commit.

ryan: adding provider constraint patch in a small PR now. quick snippet i'll add to the root module:

```
provider "google" {
  version = "~> 4.1.0"
}
```

ryan: tagging the PR with `canary-required` and assigning @kevin.

kevin: :thumbsup: i'll run the canary and execute the smoke script (lb ping + auth checks). leaving a 15m observation window after apply before next stage.

ops-bot: canary apply started in staging-canary at 2024-05-15T22:05:00Z by kevin. tailing logs: terraform apply in progress. notifications will be posted to this thread.

deploybot: apply output: 2/4 resources success so far. replacing `google_service_account` triggered a 403 on iam.setPolicy for service-mesh-sa.

maria: seeing the 403 too on the smoke runs — service account missing delegated role. holding further rollout.

sasha: HOLD PROD — DO NOT PROMOTE. we need a manual grant fix from security. adding rollback instructions below for staging if apply is irrecoverable:

```
# rollback staging quick steps
aws s3 cp s3://tfstate-backups/staging/2024-05-15-20:00.tfstate ./terraform.tfstate
git checkout -f abc12345-release-v2.7.2
terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve
```

kevin: i'll apply the manual grant now and re-run plan. will post results in ~20m.

maria: updating the release notes: "IAM: service-mesh SA permissions tightened — manual grant required during upgrade. See runbook." tagging @security and adding the runbook link.

ops-bot: monitoring note — if canary fails again, auto-rollback threshold = 2 consecutive failed resources OR >30% regressions in smoke tests.

kevin: hotfix applied, re-running plan. if green i'll resume canary at 22:40 PST.

sasha: thanks everyone. leaving prod pin until we confirm 1h stable post-canary. i'll add a line in the release changelog and call out the provider pin so SREs are prepared.
